learning_outcomes.text: Students know initial methods of project management, design systematics, quality planning, programming, self-management, project documentation, and presentation techniques.
Students are able to apply these methods purposefully for solving a technical task in a team.
They can critically review and analyze their own work methods and solution approaches and evaluate them in comparison to other teams.
Students have the social and technical competence to organize themselves in a team and are able to moderate a team purposefully.

syllabus_topics: Processing of a technical task in a team
Conception, design, construction, and commissioning of a technical system
Presentation of concepts and technical solutions
Creation of protocols and technical documentation
Collaboration and division of tasks in a team

assessment_methods.method: Combined examination (study project work and oral examination)

assessment_rules: Credit points are awarded upon successful completion of the module examination.
